get_supported_openai_params: get supported OpenAI parameters for a Fireworks AI model such as temperature and top_p
map_openai_params: map OpenAI parameters into optional params dict filtering by supported parameter list
transform_text_completion_request: transform a text completion request into Fireworks AI format with model and prompt
FireworksAITextCompletionConfig: create a FireworksAITextCompletionConfig instance to configure text completion for Fireworks AI models
build_fireworks_completion_request: build a Fireworks AI text completion request by transforming messages and model name into API format
